s-li.section_headline: Where October sits in the year
s-li.card_subtitle_as_published: Organic only. Sponsored impressions (Nov 2025–Jun 2026) left out.
s-li.commentary_as_published: October closed above September on more posts (63 page updates against 44 in the connector count); impressions rose 8.4%, so reach per post fell. July and August remain the two biggest months.
s-li.source_platform_and_window: Sep and Oct: LinkedIn Pages via Supermetrics (105562357, organic), pulled Nov 1 2026, full months. Earlier months: LinkedIn page admin analytics (organic).

s-ig.section_headline: Where October sits in the year
s-ig.commentary_as_published: October closed 8.8% below September and well below the spring and summer. Posts with an accepted collaborator averaged 1,634 views against 412 without (Oct 1–27 read).
s-ig.source_platform_and_window: Sep and Oct: Instagram Insights via Supermetrics (IGI 17841471383675991), account views, pulled Nov 1 2026, full months. Earlier months: Instagram's own reports.

s-yt.section_headline: Where October sits in the year
s-yt.commentary_as_published: All organic since September. October closed at 3,195 views, 27.7% below September; YouTube search is the biggest source.
s-yt.source_platform_and_window: Sep and Oct: YouTube via Supermetrics (YT2), pulled Nov 1 2026, full months; no ADVERTISING traffic since August. Earlier months: YouTube Studio reports.

s-ga.section_headline: Where October sits in the year
s-ga.commentary_as_published: Moment Awards voting doubled the site: 13,182 sessions, and /vote drew 7,652 views from 6,119 people before voting closed on Oct 30. Episode pages grew 4.8% on September.
s-ga.source_platform_and_window: Sep and Oct: GA4 489265998 via Supermetrics (America/New_York), pulled Nov 1 2026, full months. Earlier months: GA4 native reports.

s-nl.section_headline: Where October sits in the year
s-nl.commentary_as_published: The step-ups are imports (5,588 of 5,753 October adds; 3,045 on Oct 26–27, after the last send). Open rate fell to 34.4% as the list grew; verified clicks per delivered email held at 0.53%.

s-syn.section_headline: Partners reposted, but rarely with their own words
s-syn.card_title: September: organic vs syndicated engagement, posts with commentary reposts
s-syn.commentary_as_published: September's lift came from WPP Media, Nancy Hall and Versant reposting with their own copy. In October partners mostly reposted without it: 35 syndicated engagements on 1,608 organic. Hand partners and guests repost copy on publish day.

s-sect.commentary_as_published: Ad tech and brands lead. Publicis and IPG voices are missing, and CPG beyond PepsiCo and pharma beyond Organon are thin.
s-sect.source_platform_and_window: October report: post log, monday.com and Teams live links; sector assigned by hand
